description:
The most intuitive desktop API client. Organize and execute REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, Server Sent Events, and gRPC. ![Yaak 2026.8.0](https://yaak.app/changelog-og/2026.8.0/banner.png?v=3) The [changelog for 2026.8.0](https://yaak.app/changelog/2026.8.0) has the full write-up, with screenshots of the headline features. Here's everything that changed. ### 🎁 New • 🔄 Import into existing workspaces ([#618](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/618), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/update-current-workspace-during-import)) • Preview imports and choose their destination ([#571](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/571)) • 🧭 JSON response breadcrumbs ([#653](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/653), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/breadcrumbs-for-json-responses)) • ✨ Example gRPC messages ([#613](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/613), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/grpc-message-example-from-proto)) • 🔑 Custom OAuth 2.0 params ([#629](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/629), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/oauth-2-0-support-adding-origin-other-headers-in-token-request)) • HTTP Digest authentication ([#628](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/628), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/native-support-for-http-digest-authentication)) • Show a home screen on new installs and after deleting the last workspace ([#660](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/660)) ### 💄 Improved • 🐧 Official Arch Linux package ([feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/add-arch-linux-install-instructions-for-official-package)) • Faster search match counting in large responses ([#612](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/612), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/improve-search-performance-for-large-responses)) • Open windows without waiting for the plugin runtime ([#616](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/616)) • Shorter agent skill description ([#625](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/625), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/shorten-the-agent-skill-description)) • Show a dot on the Info tab when a description exists ([#645](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/645), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/visible-feedback-for-information-section)) • Import Digest, NTLM, OAuth 1.0, and folder auth from Postman collections ([#667](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/667)) • Convert Postman dynamic variables to template functions on import ([#680](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/680)) ### 🛠️ Fixed • ⚡ More responsive under load ([#642](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/642), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/lately-yaak-has-been-extremely-unstable-for-me-ive-encountered-two-issues-multip)) • Disable macOS Writing Tools suggestions inside editors • Disable Writing Tools suggestions in plain inputs ([#646](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/646)) • Remove the broken Refresh item from the gRPC method picker • Fix Postman import swapping the API key name and value ([#643](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/643)) • Join cURL line continuations followed by whitespace ([#644](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/644)) • Accept responses with more than 100 headers ([#658](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/658), [feedback](https://yaak.app/feedback/posts/when-response-headers-exceed-a-certain-count-hyper-throws-error)) • Focus the confirm button when a dialog opens • Use the current time when uuid.v6 has no timestamp ([#647](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/647)) • Stop flagging an empty JSON editor as invalid • Fix the MCP server ignoring environmentId on send_http_request ([#654](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/654)) • Flush exported files to disk before the CLI reports success ([#686](https://github.com/mountain-loop/yaak/pull/686))
> *These binaries follow Yaak's [pricing terms](https://yaak.app/pricing)：free for personal use, license required for commercial use. The source is MIT licensed and can be built and run for free, for both personal and commercial use.*
